name: Algorithm
info: Algorithm: how the four oscillators modulate each other.

name: Transpose
info: Transposes the whole instrument in semitones.

name: PB Range
info: Pitch bend range in semitones.

name: Volume
info: Output volume of the instrument.

name: Panorama
info: Stereo position of the output.

name: Pan < Key
info: How much the played key moves the stereo position.

name: Pan < Rnd
info: Random stereo position of each note.

name: Tone
info: High-frequency content of the output (aliasing products).

name: Spread
info: Detunes two copies of each voice, panned left and right.

name: Glide On
info: Glides from the previous note to the new one.

name: Glide Time
info: Time a glide takes.

name: Osc-A On
info: Switches oscillator A on or off.

name: A Coarse
info: Frequency ratio of oscillator A to the played note.

name: A Fine
info: Fine frequency ratio of oscillator A, in thousandths of the coarse ratio.

name: A Freq<Vel
info: How much velocity changes the frequency of oscillator A.

name: A Quantize
info: Quantizes Freq<Vel of oscillator A to whole ratios.

name: A Fix On
info: Plays oscillator A at a fixed frequency instead of following the keyboard.

name: A Fix Freq
info: Fixed frequency of oscillator A.

name: A Fix Freq Mul
info: Multiplier of the fixed frequency of oscillator A.

name: Osc-A Level
info: Output level of oscillator A.

name: Osc-A Retrig
info: Restarts the phase of oscillator A with every note.

name: Osc-A Phase
info: Start phase of oscillator A.

name: Osc-A Lev < Vel
info: How much velocity changes the level of oscillator A.

name: Osc-A Lev < Key
info: How much the played key changes the level of oscillator A.

name: Osc-A Wave
info: Waveform of oscillator A.

name: Osc-A Feedb
info: Feedback of oscillator A onto itself (only when nothing modulates it).

name: Osc-A < Pe
info: Lets the pitch envelope modulate oscillator A.

name: Osc-A < LFO
info: Lets the LFO modulate the pitch of oscillator A.

name: Ae Attack
info: Attack time of oscillator A's envelope.

name: Ae Init
info: Initial level of oscillator A's envelope, where the attack starts.

name: Ae Decay
info: Decay time of oscillator A's envelope.

name: Ae Peak
info: Peak level of oscillator A's envelope, reached at the end of the attack.

name: Ae Sustain
info: Sustain level of oscillator A's envelope while the note is held.

name: Ae Release
info: Release time of oscillator A's envelope after the note ends.

name: Ae Mode
info: Loop mode of oscillator A's envelope: None, Loop, Beat, Sync or Trigger.

name: Ae Loop
info: Loop time of oscillator A's envelope in Loop mode.

name: Ae Retrig
info: Repeat time of oscillator A's envelope in Beat and Sync mode.

name: Ae R < Vel
info: How much velocity shortens the times of oscillator A's envelope.
